scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@libly/core && npm run build --workspace=@libly/server && npm run build --workspace=@libly/web
scripts.lint: npm run build --workspace=@libly/core && eslint apps packages
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@libly/core && tsc --noEmit --project apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/core/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run check:env
